title: Enhancement of glutaminase production through protein design and host strain modification in Bacillus amyloliquefaciens.
authors: Zou, Dian; Ding, Xiaoqi; Bao, Pengfei; Ji, Anying; Mao, Zejing; Zheng, Xianliang; Wei, Xuetuan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过蛋白设计和宿主改造提升谷氨酰胺酶产量，虽涉及分子动力学模拟和转录因子基因敲除，但核心对象是酶蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且转录因子仅作为基因操作靶点，无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Glutaminase catalyzes the hydrolysis of gamma-glutamyl groups to produce glutamic acid and ammonia, exhibiting broad-spectrum applications in food processing, fine chemicals, and pharmaceutical industries. However, its limited production efficiency constrains its industrial application. In this study, a small mutant library was constructed by rational protein design. Mutant strain HZ-12/pHY-glu3 (S467H) displayed a 100% increase in glutaminase activity. The interaction force analysis and molecular dynamics simulation revealed the mechanisms by which interaction force enhancement, binding pocket size increase, and binding conformation tightening enhanced glutaminase activity. Further, glutaminase activity-related transcription factors and respiratory chain-related genes were identified in the host strain Bacillus amyloliquefaciens HZ-12. The deletion of transcription factors genes (ccpC, phoP, nsrR, and glcR) and respiratory chain-related genes (ythAB, cydCD) significantly improved glutaminase activity. Notably, engineered strain HZ-12DeltaythAB/pHY-glu3 exhibited the highest glutaminase activity (1.08 U/mL), which was 575% higher than that of control strain HZ-12/pHY-glu3(S467H). Overall, this study developed a strategy for enhancing glutaminase activity by combining protein engineering and key gene deletion, offering valuable gene resources and engineered strains for glutaminase production.
abstract_zh: 谷氨酰胺酶催化γ-谷氨酰基团的水解，生成谷氨酸和氨，在食品加工、精细化工和制药工业中具有广泛的应用前景。然而，其有限的生产效率制约了其工业应用。本研究通过理性蛋白质设计构建了一个小型突变体文库。突变株HZ-12/pHY-glu3（S467H）的谷氨酰胺酶活性提高了100%。相互作用力分析和分子动力学模拟揭示了相互作用力增强、结合口袋尺寸增大以及结合构象收紧增强谷氨酰胺酶活性的机制。此外，在宿主菌解淀粉芽孢杆菌HZ-12中鉴定了与谷氨酰胺酶活性相关的转录因子和呼吸链相关基因。转录因子基因（ccpC、phoP、nsrR和glcR）及呼吸链相关基因（ythAB、cydCD）的缺失显著提高了谷氨酰胺酶活性。值得注意的是，工程菌株HZ-12ΔythAB/pHY-glu3表现出最高的谷氨酰胺酶活性（1.08 U/mL），比对照菌株HZ-12/pHY-glu3(S467H)高出575%。总体而言，本研究开发了一种结合蛋白质工程和关键基因缺失来增强谷氨酰胺酶活性的策略，为谷氨酰胺酶生产提供了宝贵的基因资源和工程菌株。
